suggestions: I'm grateful for finding the root cause of a memory leak at 11pm instead of giving up and blaming the framework.
I'm thankful for the azan drifting in through the window right as I'm closing my laptop for the night.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who actually explains the 'why' behind a code review comment instead of just leaving a nitpick.
I'm thankful for the first sip of teh tarik after a meeting that ran way too long.
I'm grateful for a Monday deploy that just... works, no rollback drama, no frantic Slack pings.
I'm thankful for my mum still packing extra rice for me to bring back to my apartment even though I'm 'grown up' now.
I'm grateful for the ten minutes of quiet before Subuh when the whole flat is still asleep and it's just me and my thoughts.
I'm thankful for a landlord who fixed the aircon the same day I texted, no back and forth.
I'm grateful for CI going green on the first push after three straight days of red.
I'm thankful for kopitiam uncles who remember my order without me having to say it.
I'm grateful for a payslip that clears on time, every time, and the quiet peace of mind that comes with it.
I'm thankful for rain hitting the roof hard enough to drown out the office group chat notifications for a bit.
I'm grateful for a teammate covering my on-call shift last minute so I could make it to a family dinner.
I'm thankful for the stranger on the LRT who held the door open even though the train was already packed.
I'm grateful for a weekend with absolutely nothing on the calendar, just books, football, and long naps.
